about_the_game:
Build your dream gym with Ultimate Gym Simulator


Build Your Dream Gym

Start with a small gym, buy gym equipments, keep your gym clean, increase your reputation and build the best gym ever.


Gym Equipments

Bench press, cable machine, treadmill, smith machine, and much more. Buy different gym equipments to make your gym bigger and make your customers happy. Having more gym equipments will attract more customers. You also need to repair your gym equipments when they broken.


Reputation is Important

Keep your gym clean, beat up disturbing people, buy new gym equipments to have high reputation and get more people to your gym. Punching innocent people may harm your reputation.


Different Characters

Some people may enter your gym without get a membership some of them can throw bottle to ground, having this kind of people in your gym can make other people unhappy. Every people have different expectations for your gym. If you have dirty gym or if you lack some gym equipment you may miss some of the potential customers.


Combat

You can attack anyone. You can punch and kick other people also block your opponent's strikes.


Customize Your Gym and Expand

You can paint the walls of your gym. Expanding your gym is also very important to get more space and buy new equipment.


This is a prologue version of the game so some of the content like expanding your gym is not available in this version.
